name: Canada
description: Follow Canada, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Maps show wildfire smoke forecast, air quality alerts in swath of U.S.
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and the U.S. East Coast this week.

changes.title: What to Know About Canada Wildfire Smoke and Air Quality in U.S. Cities
changes.summary: A thick plume of smoke swept across the Midwest and New England, and those conditions could linger on Friday.

changes.title: 100 million Americans across 14 states impacted by heavy smoke from Canadian wildfires
changes.summary: Smoke from wildfires in Canada is creating dangerous air quality conditions for approximately 100 million Americans in more than a dozen states. Rob Marciano has the latest.

changes.title: Is smoke in your home? Here's how to make an air purifier using a box fan
changes.summary: Smoke from wildfires in Canada and Minnesota is sending air quality indexes to record levels, posing a hazard for millions of people. Here are tips for how to breathe easier in your home. (Image credit: Finn Gomez).

changes.title: Trump Threatens Canada With Tariffs for Wildfire Smoke Over U.S.
changes.summary: The president said on Friday in a social media post that Canada was failing to manage its wildfire response as smoke has blanketed U.S. cities including New York and Chicago.

changes.title: Maps show wildfire smoke forecast, air quality alerts due to pollution from Canadian, Minnesota fires
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and Northeast U.S. this week.

changes.title: Dangerous wildfire smoke continues to blanket parts of the U.S.
changes.summary: Orange skies and heavy smoke covered large parts of the U.S. on Thursday as Canada and Minnesota grapple with wildfires. Hazardous air quality is expected to continue. (Image credit: Spencer Platt).

changes.title: Canada’s Wildfires Are Burning Through the Night
changes.summary: As overnight temperatures climb across Canada, fires that once spread more slowly after dark are burning around the clock, straining fire crews.

changes.title: Climate extremes fuel explosive wildfires in Canada and the U.S., experts say
changes.summary: One climatologist said "a perfect storm" of climate extremes primed the western U.S. for one of its worst fire seasons in a decade. Meanwhile, Canadian wildfire smoke fills the air.

changes.title: Wildfires expose millions in Midwest, Northeast to dangerous smoke
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and Northeast U.S. this week.
